recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add MedicationRequest.detectedIssue unless Pharmacy reopens and reverses the later non-bidirectional DetectedIssue design.
issue_request: FHIR-12640 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and requested a new 0..* MedicationRequest link to DetectedIssue.
initial_application: The Jira comments point to SVN-migrated commit a504c1b697fe81488480665b00364efbd46982e6, which added MedicationRequest.detectedIssue with cardinality 0..* and type Reference(DetectedIssue) to the then-authoritative MedicationRequest spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in the current build. FHIR-13150 later added guidance to the then-existing direct detectedIssue elements, but FHIR-34293 subsequently required removal of MedicationRequest.detectedIssue and MedicationDispense.detectedIssue because DetectedIssue.implicated already points to implicated therapies and FHIR references are not bidirectional. Historical commit 26e2a82259 removed the direct elements, combined-branch commit e25b1231a9ed3c4fec8abcdec9281d95a66dd10c added Medication Module guidance for DetectedIssue.implicated/search/_revinclude/containment, and FHIR-39018 reaffirmed that design as Not Persuasive to restore the element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current source intentionally omits MedicationRequest.detectedIssue and already documents the replacement association and retrieval path through DetectedIssue.implicated.

related_jiras.note: The same historical application commit added MedicationDispense.detectedIssue; it is already audited separately on the combined branch as superseded by later Pharmacy decisions.
Later STU3 issue added guidance to the direct MedicationRequest/MedicationDispense detectedIssue elements before those elements were removed; it is already audited on the combined branch.
Later Published Pharmacy decision removed MedicationRequest.detectedIssue and MedicationDispense.detectedIssue and required replacement Medication Module retrieval guidance.
Later Not Persuasive ballot issue reaffirmed non-bidirectional references and DetectedIssue.implicated/search as the intended access path.
